# AnyVideoDownloader.app

> AnyVideoDownloader is a multilingual web application providing online video downloading, format conversion, and cloud media playback tools directly in the browser with no software installation required.

## Website Details
- Website: https://anyvideodownloader.app
- Primary Language: English (with full localized interfaces for 20 languages)
- Account Requirements: No registration, account, or credit card required.

## Supported Tools and Capabilities

### 1. YouTube Video Downloader
- URL: /en/
- Supported Formats: MP4, MP3, M4A, WEBM
- Supported Resolutions: 360p, 720p HD, 1080p Full HD, 1440p, 4K Ultra HD (subject to source upload quality)
- Features: Audio track extraction, YouTube Shorts support, playlist tools.

### 2. TeraBox Video Downloader & Online Player
- URL: /en/terabox-downloader
- Functionality: In-browser streaming and direct downloading for public video files hosted on TeraBox and cloud storage platforms.
- Supported Cloud Domains:
  - terabox.com, 1024terabox.com, 1024tera.com, terabox.app, teraboxapp.com
  - nephobox.com, 4funbox.com, mirrobox.com, momerybox.com, tibibox.com, freeterabox.com
  - diskwala.com, flezen.com
- Security & Restrictions: Honors access controls. Does not bypass passwords, CAPTCHAs, or access restrictions.

### 3. Other Social & Streaming Downloader Tools
- 4K Video Downloader (/en/4k-video-downloader)
- YouTube to MP3 Converter (/en/youtube-to-mp3)
- YouTube Playlist Downloader (/en/youtube-playlist-downloader)
- YouTube to WAV Converter (/en/youtube-to-wav)
- YouTube 1080p Downloader (/en/youtube-1080p-downloader)
- Instagram Reels & Video Downloader (/en/instagram-downloader)
- Facebook Video Downloader (/en/facebook-downloader)
- Twitch Clips & VODs Downloader (/en/twitch-downloader)
- Pinterest Video Downloader (/en/pinterest-downloader)
- Dailymotion Video Downloader (/en/daily-motion-downloader)
- Vimeo Video Downloader (/en/vimeo-downloader)

## Privacy and Abuse Prevention
- Temporary authenticated media URLs are not retained or exposed publicly.
- Private network access and SSRF protections are enforced.
- Rate limiting protects upstream services against automated flooding.
